title: A set
description: A set: the state a take starts from — the app's data, its settings and its launch environment.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema the file is written against, for editors. Optional; a file is read against this Retake's schema whatever it names.

extends.description: Another set this one builds on: its fields are laid under this set's.

state.description: What the app's data starts as for a take, and whether the take's changes are kept. clean: empty but for the set's files and defaults. cloned: the app's real data with the set's on top, the take's changes thrown away. live: the real data, the take's changes kept.

files.description: Files and folders put in the app's data before launch: each key is where it goes in the app's data, such as Documents/notes.json, and its value a path relative to the directory holding retake.json. The source may use .. to share fixtures outside the project. A folder ends in / on both sides.

defaults.description: What UserDefaults.standard holds at launch: strings, numbers, booleans, and lists and dictionaries of them. null can't be stored.

environment.description: Environment variables added to the launch, for the app's own flags. DYLD_, INSIDEJOB_ and RETAKE_ are Retake's own.

arguments.description: Arguments added to the launch, such as -AppleLanguages (en).

previewAspect.description: Sizes the app's window to the App Store preview's shape for the device type recorded, 886:1920 on iPhone and 3:4 on iPad, turned in landscape; the edit crops away the rest of the screen. Otherwise the app fills the screen.

appearance.description: Holds the app to light or dark, whatever the device is set to. The launch screen, drawn before the app runs, still follows the device.
